title: Puppet Master Server System contracts
description: Canonical Server System owner contracts for durable Server/Client identity, catalog, discovery, trust, pairing, revocation, sessions, connection projections and receipts, the retained exact 26-command Server-manager inventory, and six narrowly owned pairing/trust/bootstrap commands with typed availability, permission, lifecycle, ObservableWork, and exact-return contracts. Static schemas and fixtures do not prove registration, handlers, persistence execution, runtime, or readiness.

server_bootstrap_run.title: ServerBootstrapRun
x-semantic-invariants: standalone/container bootstrap follows a successful owner claim but is not cmd.server.claim
every execution form validates the immutable execution baseline and enables normal Server execution
no bootstrap record persists pairing, session, credential, or short-code secret bytes

ephemeral_secret_handle_ref.description: Opaque process-local handle to short-lived pairing material. The handle is never a secret value; neither it nor the represented secret may be persisted in command history, receipts, events, logs, Chat, Usage, or ordinary projections.

x-semantic-invariants: for cmd.server.connect, requested_connection_mode == effective_connection_mode unless the result is a typed failure
resume returns the exact durable cursor or snapshot catch-up selected by the Server and never replays the command as new work
pairing_candidate_id is the explicit selected peer candidate and never grants trust
pairing_material_handle_ref is process-local and must be consumed before persistence
only pairing_material_sha256 may cross the durable command/receipt/event boundary
requested_pairing_method == effective_pairing_method on successful pair start
cmd.client.revoke increments trust generation and terminates every active session
request return_context is byte-identical to result return_context

x-intentional-command-nonadditions.cmd.server.reconnect: not_added; cmd.server.connect carries exact connect/reconnect/resume intent and continuity inputs under one idempotent semantic operation
x-intentional-command-nonadditions.cmd.server.resume: not_added; resume is cursor/snapshot continuation of cmd.server.connect and cannot create new work
x-intentional-command-nonadditions.cmd.client.pair.qr.import: not_added; QR import is the qr candidate source of cmd.client.pair.start and only an ephemeral secret handle plus digest crosses the command boundary
x-intentional-command-nonadditions.cmd.server.peer_candidate.select: not_added; cmd.client.pair.start requires the exact pairing_candidate_id, including tailscale/headscale peer inventory candidates, and selection never grants trust
